quality.clipscore: 2.5 * max(cosine(image,text),0); CLIP ViT-B/32; 'A photo depicts ' prefix; float32 CPU via Transformers; original 224-pixel bicubic center crop
quality.lpips: lpips 0.1.4, AlexNet v0.1, RGB resized to 512 square with bicubic; inputs [-1,1]; lower means closer to paired BF16, not necessarily better image quality
quality.limitations: Eight custom prompts and one seed per prompt. Descriptive smoke test, no statistical quality equivalence claim. CLIPScore is not a correctness, typography or human-preference guarantee. LPIPS measures changes in composition as well as degradation. No FID/KID computed on this small sample.
